faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Teaching Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the PAU Teaching Assistant recruitment is 21st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the department by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is a fixed Rs.35,000/- per month for candidates with an MSc degree and Rs.40,000/- per month for candidates with a Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc. degree in Home Science or related fields with specific OGPA/OCPA or percentage, and an M.Sc. degree in Clothing & Textiles or related fields with specific OGPA/OCPA or percentage. A Matric level Punjabi language certificate is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to send your application on plain paper with attested copies of testimonials and a bank draft to the Department of Apparel & Textile Science, PAU.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Teaching Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories is Rs. 200/-. This should be submitted as a bank draft in favor of Comptroller, Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for this recruitment. It is advisable to check the detailed advertisement for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Teaching Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the submission of applications with attested copies of testimonials and a bank draft, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the interview for the Teaching Assistant position going to be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Department of Apparel & Textile Science, Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana. The exact address is PAU, Ludhiana - 141004.

faq.question: Q9. What documents do I need to submit with my application?
faq.answer: You need to submit attested copies of your testimonials (educational certificates, mark sheets, etc.) along with the application form and the bank draft.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for this post?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment requires an offline application. You need to send your application form via post or submit it in person as per the instructions in the official notification.
